**Finding submitted — deviation (IP: Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

- **What the document says:** §2(d) is the only ownership clause and it runs one way (TrueLink retains all ownership in the Interface — unobjectionable). Client-side coverage is only confidentiality treatment (§10(b)/(c), deeming Client's IP and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" Client Proprietary Information) and a narrow post-termination line that Client retains ownership of domains and Client Content (§13). §8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide right to use, license, resell and exploit Credit Data, bounded by the narrow Credit Data definition and the Non-Competition Agreement.
- **Why it fails:** No ownership of, or assignment of, the Support Services work product Client pays for; no licence-back for embedded TrueLink IP; no affirmative reservation of Client's rights in its Content, IP and borrower/loan data. That falls short of both the preferred and fallback positions.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new §2(e) "Client Ownership" inserted after p0029 — Client retains its Content, IP and borrower data with no transfer beyond the existing §8(d) licence; TrueLink assigns results of the Support Services; perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to any embedded TrueLink IP; no joint ownership. TrueLink's Interface ownership and the Credit Data bargain are left untouched.
